task.title: L8b.3-L8b.5: dynamic probe, qualified list and labels, Settings registration UI and the effective profile
task.objective: Finish Phase L L8b (awkit-djnl.12). L8b.3: the CPU utility host gains a probe request that loads a confined model, generates a few unconstrained tokens after the product's own thinking-off prompt and reports only whether they opened a think block, then answers a fixed schema under its grammar and releases the model; a pure verdict decides (load, generation, thinking, output validated with parseAiOutput) and the result is recorded on the registered model with the runtime build that produced it. L8b.4: a release-owned qualified list beside the model manifest holds the historical CPU quality keys (model SHA-256, runtime build, backend, offload class, context, KV settings, feature, output budget); a pure qualification module derives the live key, the latency class (quality key plus hardware class, never claimed until measured locally) and the labels Compatible, Qualified, Compatible but unqualified and Incompatible. L8b.5: Settings shows the disk-space preflight before any copy (two-step import by a one-time token), the compatibility and qualification labels with their reasons, an explicit unverified-model acknowledgement before a registered model is used, and a re-check; AiActionRecord gains the effective profile, carried from the job outcome through the pending candidate. No new permission: every channel is AI_MANAGE, with re-authentication where it copies, admits or deletes.

security: The probe runs only in the CPU utility host on a path confined to the model root by lexical and real-path containment; the main process never loads or parses a model it did not already admit.

The probe's prompt is the host's own fixed text, never caller text. Its unconstrained tokens are read for a think marker only and never leave the host; only the grammar-constrained answer crosses, and main validates it with parseAiOutput.

No new permission or IPC surface beyond AI_MANAGE: preflight, import, re-check and acknowledgement re-authenticate; the renderer names a picked file only by a one-time token and never supplies a path.
A registered model is used only when its static and probe stages passed for the pinned runtime build AND an administrator acknowledged it as unverified; a new import requires a new acknowledgement.
offline: Nothing is downloaded. The qualified list is release-owned source under src/offline; the host change regenerates the signed dependency manifest through a fresh package from a clean tree.

acceptance.description: The host's probe confines the path, loads on the CPU backend only, generates the unconstrained think check and the grammar-constrained answer from its own prompt, returns only the verdict facts, releases the model, is cancellable, and reports a load failure as an answer; every new guard mutation-tested.

The pure probe verdict fails each check on its own and reads a malformed reply as a failure, never a pass; a cancelled probe is not run; the stages record only on the model they ran on; old registries load, forged ones are unreadable; a compatible model is still refused until acknowledged.
On the real host and runtime the curated packs and the unlisted Qwen3.5-2B pass the probe, and the same host with the thinking-off pre-fill removed reads THINKING_NOT_DISABLED on a real model.

The qualified list holds only the historical CPU evidence (Qwen3.5-0.8B for its three limited-GO features at their product budgets); the live key qualifies exactly those and nothing on another backend, offload class, context, build, feature or budget; labels follow Incompatible, unchecked, Qualified, Compatible but unqualified.

Settings shows the preflight before copying, the labels with reasons, the acknowledgement and the re-check; channels are AI_MANAGE with re-authentication; AiActionRecord carries the effective profile and old records load.

On a fresh package: registration of an unlisted compatible GGUF with the preflight shown first, compatibility, acknowledgement and a real inference on it; a malformed GGUF and an unsupported architecture read Incompatible with their reason; the curated 0.8B reads Qualified on its CPU key.
Typecheck, bundles, script typecheck and the verifier registry pass.
